description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read the Trade plan card: suggested orders, their company ratings and decision reasons, buy/sell/net/leftover amounts, constraints and sellLotCoverage. Each order's amountEur is the card's Amount, sharePct its Share (percent of that side's budget), rating its Rating (0-100, 50 neutral, null for funds/crypto) and, on sells, taxFreeValueEur/nextMaturity its Tax-free now column; the card's Run historical backtest button opens the historical simulation the backtest_trades tool runs. tradePlanning carries saved controls; planning describes the result. Invest is new money; sales are independent and their proceeds stay cash. Every amount uses displayCurrency; the Eur suffix is legacy. Each '…Eur' field now also ships under its currency-neutral name (amountEur→amount, buyEur→buy, valueEur→value, totalEur→totalAmount); the '…Eur' twins are DEPRECATED and will be removed — read the neutral name. include:['candidates'] adds ranked candidates with inclusion, exclusion or cap reasons; ['taxOrientation'] adds tax lots. Funds/crypto have no company rating. No orders are placed. Default notes are brief; docs carries docs_lookup labels for the simplified planner, verbose:true includes full notes. unavailableReason explains a missing plan. symbols {buys, sells} lists the plan's tickers, ready to pass as `symbols` to holding, market_lookup, price_on or trade_candidates in ONE call. Each sell order carries taxFreeValueEur/taxFreeQty (the whole position's tax-free capacity today) beside taxFreeEur (the exempt slice of that one order), and nextMaturity {date, qty, valueEur} — the earliest still-future time-test date for that holding, what to report when taxFreeValueEur is 0 ('nothing is tax-free today; the next lot matures on …'); null where no open lot has a maturity date at all. The same orders and contextRevision are in get_context portfolio.tradePlan.
